# Results summary (generated by conversion_model.py; every number below comes from this run)

- Sessions: 472,871; orders: 32,313; overall conversion 6.83%
- Train: 2012-03-19 to 2014-09-30 (332,300 sessions, 6.32% conversion)
- Test: 2014-10-01 to 2015-03-19 (140,571 sessions, 8.06% conversion, 170 days)

## Model performance on the test months

| Model | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC | Top-decile conv. | Top-decile lift | Share of orders in top decile | Brier (corrected) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Logistic regression | 0.609 | 0.104 | 11.13% | 1.38x | 13.8% | 0.0731 |
| Gradient boosting (HistGB) | 0.607 | 0.103 | 10.50% | 1.30x | 13.0% | 0.0732 |
| Baseline: segment rate (device x source x landing) | 0.602 | 0.101 | 9.99% | 1.24x | 12.4% | 0.0732 |

- PR-AUC of a random ranking = test conversion rate = 0.081. Brier of a constant train-rate prediction = 0.0744.
- Calibration: class-weighted raw scores average 0.535 (LR), far above the real rate, as expected from re-weighting. After the prior correction they average 0.0805 (LR) / 0.0733 (GB) vs an observed 0.0806. Mean absolute gap between predicted and observed across 10 quantile bins: LR 0.0059, GB 0.0080 (see charts/calibration.png).

## Mobile fix vs landing-page fix (test window, logistic regression, re-levelled)

- AOV (test window): $63.32
- Mobile fix: 42,454 sessions, +3,004 orders, +$190,211 over 170 days (~$408,393/yr annualised; model as-is without re-levelling: +$190,130)
- Same mobile counterfactual scored by gradient boosting: +2,863 orders, +$181,267
- Landing-page fix (best lander per device: {'desktop': '/lander-5', 'mobile': '/lander-3'}): 10,376 sessions, +225 orders, +$14,256 (~$30,608/yr; as-is +$14,250)
- Mobile fix is worth 13.3x the landing-page fix.

## Reconciliation with the SQL project

- SQL $282K reproduced (report says $282,404; difference is rounding): 87,551 gsearch-nonbrand mobile sessions x (8.22% - 3.18%) x $64 = $282,405 (3 years, assumed $64 AOV). With the actual AOV $59.99: $264,537.
- Naive desktop-rate-on-mobile gap in the test window (all mobile traffic): $177,364.
- ~$322K funnel figure: +5pp cart rate on 162,525 Mr. Fuzzy sessions = 8,126 extra carts. At the observed cart-to-order rate (34.0%) and AOV that is $165,901; even if every extra cart became an order it is $487,507. It is a product-page-to-cart fix, which this start-of-session model cannot evaluate (those pageviews are excluded as leakage).
